calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks,
           COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.stores, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

SELECT 'sales' AS t, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-26'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), 0
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-26'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock-less store check', count(*), count(DISTINCT store_id), 0, min(open_date), max(close_date), 0 FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dups) AS total_dup_keys
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 24

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.store_key) stores, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, sum(f.net_amount) net,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_in_q3,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n_in_q3_ly
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no)

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctl
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND c.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year, c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id, c.store_id) store_id, m.mine, c.ctl, ROUND(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0),2) AS diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year AND m.store_id=c.store_id
WHERE abs(COALESCE(m.mine,0)-COALESCE(c.ctl,0)) > 0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sw AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) ns, COUNT(*) days, SUM(CASE WHEN c.net_sales<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) days_with_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND c.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
avgs AS (SELECT store_id, fiscal_year, avg(ns) a FROM sw GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT sw.fiscal_year, sw.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, sw.fiscal_week, round(sw.ns,0) ns, round(a.a,0) avg_wk, sw.days_with_sales
FROM sw JOIN avgs a USING (store_id, fiscal_year) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=sw.store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE sw.ns < 0.4*a.a OR sw.store_id IN (129,136,137)  AND sw.fiscal_week>=37
ORDER BY 2,1,5

store_weeks AS (

lfl_store_weeks AS (

      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order

),
net_lines AS (

CROSS JOIN params
